segments.text:
V. 33.
He put his fingers into his cars—Perhaps intending to teach us, That we are not to preſcribe to Him (as they who brought this Man attempted to do) but to expect his Bleſſing by whatſoever Means He pleaſes: Even tho' there ſhould be no Proportion or Reſemblance between the Means uſed, and the Benefit to be conveyed thereby.
